tools.name: phone_connection
tools.title: Phone connection
tools.description: Check the actual connection and current server/catalog version, including when the phone is offline.

tools.name: phone_catalog
tools.description: Live operation catalog. Request an operation for its current arguments schema. The stable gateways automatically use this catalog after server updates.

tools.name: phone_read
tools.description: Read through the stable API. Discover operation and arguments with phone_catalog. New read operations are available automatically.

tools.name: phone_action
tools.description: Execute an authorized write through the stable API. Discover its current arguments with phone_catalog. New actions are available automatically.

tools.name: phone_status
tools.description: Session, permissions, displays, Android and installed app version.

tools.name: phone_diagnostics
tools.description: On-demand battery, CPU, memory and Phone MCP wakelock counters. Does not read app contents.

tools.name: phone_diagnostic_probe
tools.description: Run or retrieve a bounded two-sample battery observation without a wakelock. It can outlive a stopped Phone MCP service.

tools.name: phone_session_create
tools.description: Create a separately routed app session. requestId is an idempotent UUID; keep the returned sessionId. Does not launch the app. The physical-screen policy is selected only in local Phone MCP settings. keepRendering=true preserves visual background work during pauses at a higher idle cost. After a successful user handoff, create a new requestId/session; the former session stays terminated. Explicit local Stop still requires local resumption.

tools.name: phone_session_wake
tools.description: Recover only the existing AI display under the screen policy selected locally in Phone MCP settings. This tool cannot enable the physical-screen-on mode or change the local setting. It does not relaunch the app or bypass keyguard. If off-screen recovery fails, report it instead of choosing a lit-screen fallback.

tools.name: phone_session_cleanup
tools.description: Remove empty abandoned task records for an authorized app. Active and physical tasks are always preserved. Optional taskIds migrate identified legacy AI tasks; no live app is closed.

tools.name: phone_session_list
tools.description: List this authorization’s active and ended app sessions, their displays, isolation and lease state.

tools.name: phone_session_keepalive
tools.description: Extend a legitimate thinking pause for an active session. Does not restart an ended or locally stopped session.

tools.name: phone_session_end
tools.description: Finish this app session and release its display and preview. A different app session continues.

tools.name: phone_session_cancel
tools.description: Interrupt only this app session and reject its queued commands. A locally stopped app requires local resumption.

tools.name: phone_notifications
tools.description: Read current notifications for an authorized app without opening it.

tools.name: phone_reply_notification
tools.description: Send the requested reply through a freshly observed notification.

tools.name: phone_snapshot
tools.description: Read an authorized window. Reuse an action observation. A cursor reads more nodes from the same unchanged snapshot.

tools.name: phone_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the authorized window. For black or incomplete images try captureSource=surface: a fresh frame from the owned non-secure virtual display, without changing app state or physical-screen power. Optional labels map through coordinateSpace.

tools.name: phone_open_app
tools.description: Open an authorized app on the active control display. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_open_url
tools.description: Open an HTTPS URL in the chosen authorized app on the active display. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_click
tools.description: Click an observed node. Legacy longPressNodeId and coordinateActions remain supported. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_long_press
tools.description: Long press an observed node, for example to open its context menu. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_set_text
tools.description: Replace an observed editable field, excluding protected fields. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_scroll
tools.description: Scroll an observed scrollable node. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_back
tools.description: Go back within the observed authorized window. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_tap
tools.description: Tap a freshly observed target. Canvas/game areas require a recent screenshot tied to the same snapshot; unrelated animation does not invalidate a stable target. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_swipe
tools.description: Swipe within the freshly observed window and stable geometry. For canvas/game areas, first capture the same snapshot. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_action_sequence
tools.description: Execute up to 8 already observed taps/swipes locally in one bounded command, with one final observation. Prefer one swipe for a drag or two taps for source/destination. Every step keeps the original session, app, window and target guards. Stops at the first failure; inspect executedCount and failedStep, never replay the whole sequence. Does not bypass app timers, protected content or reward conditions. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_ad_start
tools.description: Start one bounded local ad-closing job on an existing app session. The phone waits and closes available controls across successive ad windows without model round trips. Supply observed app returnTargets; for a graphical game, save its host windowId before the ad, then use by=windowId/exact only after another ad window opens. Available close/skip controls are preferred. Hidden ad controls can be revealed with bounded neutral taps; visual skip icons need positive pixel evidence beside an observed badge. It never skips observed timers or claims rewards; follow ad_status, or ad_cancel. Reuse requestId only for the same job.

tools.name: phone_ad_status
tools.description: Read a local ad job with a bounded long poll. completed confirms an observed returnTarget, not a reward. Keep the exact packageName, sessionId and jobId. Read-only: never clicks or starts another job.

tools.name: phone_ad_cancel
tools.description: Cancel only this local ad job immediately. It does not end or resume its app session. Actions already delivered may have taken effect; inspect the returned state before continuing.

tools.name: phone_set_control_mode
tools.description: Explicitly select foreground or parallel, preserving the existing session and permissions.

tools.name: phone_files_list
tools.description: List Phone MCP transfers and recent installation jobs. Requires Shizuku.

tools.name: phone_send_file
tools.description: Send a user-selected or generated chat file to the phone. Pass the host file object; no URL needs to be created, copied or published by the user. Follow file_job until completed.

tools.name: phone_upload_begin
tools.description: Prepare a direct binary transfer from a local client, without hosting the file. Reuse requestId only for the same file. Return jobId, offset and an authenticated relative upload path.

tools.name: phone_upload_commit
tools.description: Finish a fully received binary transfer; SHA-256 and exact size must match before the file becomes completed. Follow file_job; incomplete or mismatched bytes are never published as completed.

tools.name: phone_download_file
tools.description: Download an HTTPS file, up to 512 MiB. Follow its job; reuse requestId after an uncertain result.

tools.name: phone_file_job
tools.description: Inspect a transfer/install, or cancel a transfer. Only completed confirms success.

tools.name: phone_install_apk
tools.description: Install the specified transferred APK via Shizuku, checking its SHA-256 and package. Follow the job.

tools.name: phone_stop
tools.description: Stop the phone session. Restarting requires a local action.

tools.name: phone_find_nodes
tools.description: Find matching accessible elements on the active display, including later pages.

tools.name: phone_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for a matching element, returning found=false on timeout. Never repeats an action.

tools.name: phone_wait_and_click
tools.description: Wait locally up to 8 seconds for one exact visible, enabled, unprotected accessible target, then click once and return its final observation. Timeout returns found=false and performed=false. Ambiguous matches are refused; no coordinate guessing, no timer skipping or action retries. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_wait_for_idle
tools.description: Wait until the observed accessibility content is stable; returns idle=false on timeout.

tools.name: phone_node_details
tools.description: Read the full text and state of one freshly observed, unprotected node.

tools.name: phone_double_tap
tools.description: Double tap inside the freshly observed window and stable target; canvas areas require a recent screenshot. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_pinch
tools.description: Pinch or zoom inside the freshly observed window and stable target; canvas areas require a recent screenshot. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_edit_text
tools.description: Append, insert, clear or replace an observed non-protected editable field. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_press_key
tools.description: Submit the observed editable field using its Android IME Enter action. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_scroll_to_node
tools.description: Ask Android to bring an observed node into view. Find with includeOffscreen first. Returns observation with a fresh snapshot after the action.

tools.name: phone_notification_dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a freshly observed clearable notification.

tools.name: phone_notification_snooze
tools.description: Snooze a freshly observed notification.

tools.name: phone_storage_locations
tools.description: List folders explicitly selected on the phone. Works without Shizuku.

tools.name: phone_list_files
tools.description: List a path inside an explicitly selected folder.

tools.name: phone_read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside a selected folder, with line pagination.

tools.name: phone_write_file
tools.description: Create or explicitly replace a UTF-8 file in a selected folder. Text is bounded to 16,000 JSON characters and 24,000 UTF-8 bytes. Overwrite requires overwrite=true.

tools.name: phone_delete_file
tools.description: Delete the requested file inside a selected folder. Directories are refused.

tools.name: phone_shared_content
tools.description: List content deliberately shared to Phone MCP through Android Share.

tools.name: phone_read_shared_file
tools.description: Read a shared text file or image. Does not access other app files.
